report.scope: Candidate16HBT/3nativeLVNMOS/12nativeR CML master/slave sampler with external8GHz clock,10ohm data/clock sources,1.65V data commonmode,500uA idealbias and1pF/output stress. Slave-only native emitter bleed length12.8um(data)/9.6um(hold) instead of38.4um; stronger native input pullups L2.4um instead of3.6um; fourfold total HBT emitter count/tail width/collector resistor width relative to original hybrid sampler; each formerly invalid Nx16 clock device is two separate native Nx8 devices. This lumped stress is not the distributed extracted parent load. Clean zero-sourceOP/OFF readback,256sourcebits,full34.25ns native trajectory. No RX/XOR loading, recovered clock, physical parasitics or fullCDR/PHY acceptance.
